candidates.name: Tetralogy of Fallot
support_spans: severe dilation of the right atrium and right ventricle
a markedly hypoplastic left ventricle
two great vessels arising in parallel from the right ventricle
candidates.why: The combination of right ventricular dilation, left ventricular hypoplasia, and parallel great vessels is consistent with Tetralogy of Fallot.

candidates.name: Tricuspid Atresia
support_spans: severe tricuspid regurgitation
right atrium and right ventricle dilation
candidates.why: The presence of severe tricuspid regurgitation and right heart dilation suggests Tricuspid Atresia.

candidates.name: Ebstein's Anomaly
support_spans: severe tricuspid regurgitation
right atrium and right ventricle dilation
candidates.why: The mechanism of tricuspid valve abnormality and right heart dilation is consistent with Ebstein's Anomaly.

candidates.name: Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome
support_spans: a markedly hypoplastic left ventricle
severely reduced mitral valve orifice
candidates.why: The underdevelopment of the left ventricle and mitral valve is characteristic of Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome.

candidates.name: Atrial Septal Defect
support_spans: a 16 mm interatrial defect in the upper septum
agitated saline contrast injected via the left jugular vein produced bubbles in the left atrium and ventricle
candidates.why: The presence of an interatrial defect and the bubble contrast study confirm the diagnosis of Atrial Septal Defect.

candidates.name: Ventricular Septal Defect
support_spans: a 6 mm muscular interventricular defect in the dorsal septum
bidirectional shunting at both septal defects
candidates.why: The presence of an interventricular defect and bidirectional shunting confirms the diagnosis of Ventricular Septal Defect.
